answer: Use scarce vouching: each established agent can endorse only three newcomers per epoch, and that endorsement stays liable for 90 days. If a newcomer is proven to be a duplicate, its endorser loses endorsement rights and accumulated reputation. An attacker therefore cannot spin up an island of fake accounts alone; he must recruit or slowly grow many independent endorsers, each risking real standing. Like trees in an orchard, trust grows slowly and cannot be cloned instantly, and an echo of linked endorsements reveals clusters run by one operator.
